text:
alex: FYI installer dropped an amd64 binary onto my arm64 Pi and `redwoodctl` fails with "ELF wrong architecture"
toni: ah, installer should detect `uname -m`. It didn't for you?
alex: installer picked default asset and silently overwrote /usr/local/bin. ran into this while provisioning a fleet
build-bot: CI shows linux/arm64 artifact build failed (job CI-2345) - linker target mismatch (musl vs glibc)
mira: short-term workaround: download the arm64 release on an x86 host and scp the correct binary to the Pi. i'll add steps to the docs
docs: also adding NOTE: installer will not clobber existing profiles in next patch. if you use dotfiles/profiles set REDWOODCTL_PROFILE env var to avoid accidental overwrites
toni: tracking: DEVEX-472 (installer arch detection) and DEVEX-473 (do not ship default profiles). will cut a hotfix with an explicit arch check and `--force-arch` flag
alex: thanks, leaving my manual scp steps in my bootstrap script for now
